title: knowledge-order
description: The order <=_k of a pre-bilattice's knowledge lattice - the componentwise product order on charges: it raises both positive and negative evidence together. Its bottom is no-evidence, its top evidence-both-ways.

componentwise.description: [a1,a2] <=_k [b1,b2] iff a1 <= b1 and a2 <= b2 - both evidence slots raised together; negation is monotone in it
